watches.name: M8
watches.description: The M8 by features a 41mm stainless steel 316L case and is just 7mm thick for elegance! Its curved acrylic crystal protects a black or vintage white dial, powered by the reliable Seiko VH31 movement. Choose a leather strap, stainless steel mesh strap or nato strap, each with a 20mm lug size. It’s water-resistant up to 5ATM and comes with a two-year warranty. The M8 blends durability with timeless style, perfectly complementing your look!

watches.name: PHILOSOPHER-BK
watches.description: The PHILOSOPHER - BLACK boasts a stunning 40mm diamond powder blasted Matte black stainless steel case and secure screw-back! Its exquisite enamel matte dial featuring 1 Big hand with Swiss Super Luminova is shielded by a domed sapphire lens with AR coating. Driven by the remarkable Seiko NH38 automatic movement, offering a 42-hour power reserve, it comes with a luxurious 20mm Italian calf leather strap. Every single detail radiates Trifoglio Italia’s impeccable craftsmanship and incredible style! 2 year warrantyIf you like a different colour strap let us know by going into our strap collection and we'll swap it for you.

watches.name: SETTEVENTI
watches.description: SetteVenti, the second watch, embodies the brand's journey to excellence. Imagine wearing a piece of art, 45mm - 10 ATM crafted with timeless elegance and featuring a domed lens. Its stainless steel back and secure screw-in design ensure durability. The sandblasted case exudes refined character, paired with a double leather Nato strap for lasting comfort. Trifoglio Italia seamlessly blends innovation with craftsmanship, offering you both strength and sophistication. Don’t miss out on embracing resilience and style with SetteVenti, a reflection of our unwavering dedication to luxury and quality. 3 Nato straps are included in this sale. 1 year Warranty.

watches.name: VOYAGER
watches.description: The VOYAGER features a world map embossed on the dial. 41mm, slim Stainless Steel 316L case. With a choice of Black, Grey or white dial. It pairs with a 20mm leather or stainless steel mesh strap, offers 5ATM water resistance, and a 1-year warranty, embodying Trifoglio Italia’s dedication to quality.

watches.name: RADIO CITY II
watches.description: The RADIO CITY II by Trifoglio Italia exudes timeless elegance with a 42mm stainless steel matte black case and 7mm thickness. Its black and white enamel dial, protected by K1 mineral crystal, features the precise Miyota GL20 movement. With interchangeable leather and mesh straps, a 20mm lug size, 5ATM water resistance, and a 2-year warranty, it showcases Trifoglio Italia’s craftsmanship and style.

watches.name: PHILOSOPHER
watches.description: The 1 hand of the PHILOSOPHER Watch exudes timeless elegance with a 40mm Matte sandblasted stainless steel 316L case.. It boasts a domed, AR-coated sapphire lens, enamel matte dial with Swiss Super-Luminova, and minute markers printed under the crystal. Powered by the Seiko NH38 automatic movement with a 42-hour power reserve, it guarantees precision and durability. Italian calf leather strap with a 20mm lug size enhances its sophistication. 2 Year Warranty. Elevate your collection with this meticulously crafted watch showcasing superior craftsmanship and style.If you require a different colour strap from our strap collection, just send us a message and we will accommodate you

watches.name: SPAX-JEYO
watches.description: The SPAX-JEYO by Trifoglio Italia is the epitome of precision and style with its 41mm case, dome sapphire lens, and Seiko NH35 movement, guaranteeing exceptional timekeeping. The deep blue Aventurine dial, inspired by the stars Orion and Betelgeuse, commands attention with its unique shimmer. The watch strap is both stylish and enduring for him or her, a testament to Trifoglio Italia's masterful craftsmanship. Embrace a watch that impeccably fuses performance and artistry.

watches.name: VAULT II (Pre-Order Here or Back Us on Kickstarter!)
watches.description: The VAULT-II Watch is now on Kickstarter! You can either PRE-ORDER here on our website or back us on KICKSTARTER. Note that prices might vary due to exchange rates and prices on our website includes shipping while on Kickstarter, shipping is charged separately. VAULT-II (Second Generation)The Timepiece That Carries More Than Time Introducing the VAULT-II, a new generation of luxury watchmaking designed around an idea as practical as it is distinctive: your watch can carry the things you value most. At the heart of the VAULT-II is an integrated, precision-engineered personal storage container, seamlessly incorporated into the watch design. Designed to discreetly hold small personal essentials such as medical pills, a SIM card, jewelry, or other valuables, the hidden container transforms the traditional wristwatch into a sophisticated personal vault. For those who prefer a cleaner, slimmer profile, the VAULT-II can be worn with or without the container. This modular approach allows the wearer to choose between the distinctive functionality of the complete VAULT-II or the refined minimalism of the watch alone. Built to uncompromising specifications, the VAULT-II features a 40mm 316L Polished Stainless Steel case, 10 ATM water resistance, a surgical steel container that attaches to the case back, a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal lens, and a distinctive finish of Vitrum Enamel shadow-tone dial that gives the watch depth, character, and a refined visual presence. Available in seven distinct variations, the collection offers a range of configurations to suit different personalities and styles while maintaining the defining identity of the VAULT-II.More than a timekeeper, the VAULT-II represents a new philosophy of personal carry: precision, protection and purpose, worn on the wrist. Delivery in Jan/Feb 2027. This is a Limited time offer.

watches.name: RADIO CITY 36mm
watches.description: The RADIO CITY 36mm features a sleek 36mm case and 5mm profile in Stainless Steel 316L, available in PVD Rose Gold or polished SS. Its two-tone enamel dial, driven by Miyota Quartz, ensures reliability. A leather strap (18mm lug) provides comfort and style. Water-resistant to 5ATM, it combines durability and luxury. Backed by a 1-year warranty, it showcases Trifoglio Italia's craftsmanship.

watches.name: VELOCE I
watches.description: The VELOCE 1 Limited Edition features a 42mm stainless steel 316L case with an 8mm thickness, highlighting Trifoglio Italia’s luxury design. The dial, inspired by Italian supercar speedometers, includes rotating discs for hours and minutes, a sweeping second hand, and luminous markers. It is powered by the Citizen/Miyota 8215 automatic movement, offering a blend of performance and design. You can choose between a genuine Italian calf leather strap or a NATO strap. The VELOCE 1 exemplifies the brand’s craftsmanship and elegance.

watches.name: MILLIMETRO IV
watches.description: The MILLIMETRO Generation 4 features a stunning 41mm stainless steel case, a sleek 8.5mm thickness, and three mesmerizing rotating discs under a sapphire lens. It proudly showcases the precise Seiko NH35 automatic movement and sports a stylish 20mm strap. With water resistance up to 10ATM and a robust 2-year warranty, this timepiece is a testament to innovation, elegance, and quality! Meticulously crafted for those who treasure sophistication, the MILLIMETRO IV elevates your style with remarkable precision, beautifully blending exquisite design and functionality into pure luxury!

watches.name: MESH 22mm
watches.description: Discover the epitome of style and durability with our 22mm MESH watch straps in Stainless Steel. Designed for the modern connoisseur, these straps marry classic elegance with robust functionality. Crafted from premium 316L Stainless Steel, our MESH ensures maximum comfort and longevity, adding a versatile touch to any luxury timepiece. Elevate your style effortlessly with Trifoglio Italia's commitment to timeless elegance and exceptional craftsmanship. (Fits all our models)

watches.name: VELOCE II
watches.description: The VELOCE 2 Limited Edition features a 42mm stainless steel 316L case, 8mm thick, showcasing Trifoglio Italia’s "luxury" and "precision." Inspired by Italian supercar speedometers, its dial has rotating discs for hours and minutes, a sweeping second hand, and luminous markers. Powered by the Citizen/Miyota 8215 automatic movement, it embodies meticulous craftsmanship and timeless elegance. Designed for those appreciating refined details and superior engineering, the VELOCE II elevates your style with understated sophistication. Experience Italy "excellency" through a fusion of innovation and heritage.

watches.name: PHILOSOPHER-SKULL
watches.description: Philosopher Skull — an uncompromising statement in haute horlogerie. Encased in a rare FROST-finish 40mm shell, a painstaking technique mastered by only a handful of luxury houses, the surface catches light like powdered steel: satin-minimal yet tactilely complex, whispering mechanical rigor. Beneath a flat, anti-reflective sapphire lens, a large skull - precisely lasered into the dial - balances refined brutality with surgical detail, its micro-engraved shadows giving depth without ostentation. Powered by the reliable automatic Seiko NH-38 movement, the piece pairs technical integrity with ritual aesthetics and 10 ATM water resistance. A hand-stitched Florentine saddle-leather strap, sewn by a single artisan, ages to a unique patina that honours provenance and time. For collectors who prize rarity and craft, the Philosopher Skull is both a worn talisman and a technical triumph - scarcity, complication, and heritage distilled into one unforgettable watch.

watches.name: RADIO CITY 40mm
watches.description: The RADIO CITY 40mm defines Trifoglio Italia’s sophistication with a robust 5mm thick, 40mm square 316L case in PVD Rose Gold or Black. A resilient K1 mineral crystal shields its stunning two-tone enamel dial, driven by a reliable Citizen/Miyota movement. Stainless steel mesh straps with a 20mm lug guarantee both comfort and style. With water resistance up to 5ATM, it promises enduring quality and timeless elegance.

watches.name: MESH 20mm - 3 Colours (Silver, Rose Gold & Black)
watches.description: Discover our 20mm MESH watch straps, blending style and durability. Made for modern enthusiasts, these elegant straps feature cutting-edge functionality. Crafted from 316L Stainless Steel, they offer lasting comfort and luxury. At Trifoglio Italia, elevate your style with timeless accessories that reflect your taste for luxury.

watches.name: PORTOFINO SKULL BANGLE
watches.description: Discover the essence of timeless elegance with the PORTOFINO SKULL BANGLE from Trifoglio Italia. Expertly crafted for those who appreciate distinctive luxury, this striking bangle features a bold skull design that effortlessly merges modern edge with classic sophistication. Perfect for elevating any ensemble, this statement piece showcases Trifoglio Italia's unparalleled artistry and dedication to quality. Whether complementing our exquisite range of luxury watches or standing alone, the PORTOFINO SKULL BANGLE is an embodiment of refined style and understated power.
